browser_observations: Live diagnostics displayed the actual undeclared-name code SEM-02 and file:line:column.
Formatting and a reviewed variable rename preserved behavior; the separate Run window printed 42.
A saved test case passed, and all seven bundled language examples passed through the test explorer.
IndexedDB recovery history displayed manual and before-formatting checkpoints.
A primitive was added to a 3D scene draft, changed to a sphere at X=2, rendered from actual VM initialization, and compiled/applied to source.
A 12-number request generated a checked main/module project; its fixture passed in the real VM.
A follow-up staged Edit operations for the existing main/module pair, passed compilation and one example test, and preserved unrelated files.
Keyboard resizing changed the agent width to 340; reset restored defaults. Large-text, contrast and reduced-motion settings updated rendered state.
The release tab displayed real export evidence and Not Run labels for Windows execution, installer installation and signing.
limitations: Constrained local classifier, planners and code builders; no unrestricted code LLM, model service or new training run.
Advanced refactoring remains limited to unambiguous supported symbols; generic/overloaded/member renaming is refused.
Native Windows execution, Inno Setup compilation/installation and publisher signing were not performed in this Linux development session.
Git and disk repository integration require Node 20+, Git and an explicitly configured local workspace root; unavailable on the hosted preview.
Scene editing handles literal object properties and top-down placement; not full mesh/animation/tilemap authoring or gameplay verification.
Browser recovery is local browser storage with bounded retention; browser data removal removes that history.
Folder picker access depends on browser support; Windows graphical/file picker operation was not tested.
No current FPS/audio/memory benchmarks or narrow-screen execution measurement was performed.
Console login/hub demo retains its existing memory-only, visible-passphrase limitations.
